info.title: 2dog
info.description: 2dog command-line tool and project templates. `dnx 2dog` interactively creates a Godot project with .NET hosts, or adds hosts (desktop, browser-wasm, xUnit, WinForms) to an existing one; every prompt has a flag, so `2dog new MyGame --desktop --tests` runs unattended. `dotnet new install 2dog` provides the `dotnet new 2dog` project template. The engine library itself is the 2dog.engine package.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add hosts to an existing Godot project

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Alias of add, for projects that have no hosts yet

commands.name: hosts
commands.description:
--desktop [folder]  Desktop host (your own Main entry point)
--web [folder]      Browser (WebAssembly) host
--tests [folder]    xUnit test project
--winforms [folder] WinForms host embedding the game window
(Windows-only; never part of the default set)
--no-desktop, --no-web, --no-tests
Leave a host out of the default set
